scope: Artifacts created by the local photonic and compiler simulation task

files.disposition: Retain original bytes; lines identify initial harness failures and completion
Retain original bytes; lines identify each physical setting verdict

launchers: The task used direct tmux commands and the retained repository shell launcher; it created no temporary launcher file
environments: The task used the pre-existing system and pinned Quantum Inspire interpreters; it created no virtual environment or package cache
generated_cache_policy: Python bytecode caches are regenerable interpreter output, outside the retained scientific denominator; source and producer digests bind their reproducible inputs
shared_temporary_artifacts: Other photonic-named gate ledgers, timings and launchers belong to the coordinating integration tasks and stay outside this task's ownership
